title: Beer Bread, Israeli Salad And Tahini Sauce
notes: Try these side dishes with the Shakshuka recipe on the following page.

ingredientSections.heading: Beer Bread
items: 1½ Cups beer (Hefeweizen is a good choice)

methodSections.heading: Beer Bread
steps: Mix all the ingredients, except the coconut oil, together in a large bowl forming a wet dough.
Grease a bread pan with the coconut oil.
Place the dough into the pan and sprinkle generously with sesame seeds.
Bake for 45-60 minutes or until the crust is nicely browned and cracked.

methodSections.heading: Israeli Salad
steps: Slice all the vegetables and herbs finely and mix together in a bowl.
Squeeze the juice from the lemons over the vegetables.
Add the olive oil, salt and pepper and mix together well.
Taste and adjust the seasoning and acidity if necessary.

methodSections.heading: Tahini Sauce
steps: Mince the garlic and make sure the tahini paste is well stirred so the oil isn’t separated.
Add all ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
Adjust the consistency with water if necessary.
